title: Advert template and reply
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y8 lesson 31 (Pupil PDF worksheet: advert template and reply)
intro: Lesson 31: Simple job adverts. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text:
مَطْلُوب: مُعَلِّمُ قُرْآنٍ لِلْأَطْفَالِ
المَكَان: مَسْجِدٌ فِي شَرْقِ لَنْدَن
الأَيَّام: السَّبْت وَالأَحَد، مِنَ السَّاعَةِ العَاشِرَةِ صَبَاحًا
الشُّرُوط: الصَّبْرُ وَحُبُّ الأَطْفَالِ
لِلتَّوَاصُلِ: اُكْتُبْ إِلَى إِدَارَةِ المَسْجِدِ

questions.q: What does the advert ask for in الشُّرُوط?
Write your own five-line advert on the pupil PDF (e.g. a volunteer at a food bank, a helper at a library), then a two-sentence reply to a partner's advert in the portal response box.
questions.a: Advert with the five parts; reply e.g. أُرِيدُ هٰذِهِ الوَظِيفَةَ لِأَنَّنِي صَبُورٌ.

questions.q: Extend: add the hours with السَّاعَة.
questions.a: For example: مِنَ السَّاعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ إِلَى الخَامِسَةِ

questions.q: Which days are in the advert?
questions.a: A) Saturday and Sunday. الأَيَّام: السَّبْت وَالأَحَد.

questions.q: Think again: what must a good advert include?
